svg.title: Chess: game 1, move 4
svg.desc: Game 1 of @tannergolden against GitHub, after 3... Kd8: king from e8 to d8. It is @tannergolden's turn, due by 28 Nov. White: king e1; queen d4; rooks a1 and h1; bishops c1 and f1; knights b1 and g1; pawns a2, b2, c2, d5, e2, f2, g2 and h2. Black: king d8; queen h4; rooks a8 and h8; bishops c8 and f8; knights b8 and g8; pawns a7, b7, c7, d7, e6, f7, g7 and h7.
